map_usage: The curriculum map now uses the approved Canvas composition and drawing primitives from the handoff: layered terrain, diagonal water, route-aligned bridge, tree clusters, mountains and rocks. Imported SVG primitives remain available and are used by the Phaser runner where raster textures are required.
game_usage: The Phaser runner loads 2x PNG rasterizations of the same themed tree and pine assets for stable WebGL scenery and video capture.
